top_choice_rationale: P001 awards Katori and Ye for the invention and realization of optical lattice clocks. The magic-wavelength lattice combines clean systematics with the averaging power of many neutral atoms, reaching the 1e-18 level, and it has been reproduced independently at several laboratories. The scientific achievement is mature and the two-person allocation is clean. The citation is narrow enough to avoid overlap with the 2005 and 2012 prizes. A year with no award would withhold a verified, robust result.
